newsitem.title: USA: Successories May comp-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Successories May comp-store sales rise.

text.p: Successories Inc said Thursday comparable sales for company-owned locations increased 16 percent for the four weeks ended May 31, 1997.
On a year-to-date basis, sales for stores open at least a year were up 11 percent for the four months ended May 31, 1997.

Successories, which designs, manufactures and markets proprietary products for business and personal motivation, said several new product introductions are exceeding sales projections in the retail stores.
Successories shares closed down 7/16 at 5-9/16 Thursday.
